findings.text: Solana TVL surge (z=+2.9 vs its recent baseline)

commentary: Epoch 1025 is 95% complete (~2h remaining), with the cluster processing ~4,436 TPS (2,318 non-vote). Measured slot time is 320ms — live on-chain evidence that SIMD-0525's first slot-time reduction step (350ms target) is active on mainnet. The network earned $853.6K of Real Economic Value over the last 24h ($593/minute), computed as base + priority fees plus Jito MEV tips. SOL trades at $102.79 (-2.9% / 24h). Decentralization: Nakamoto coefficient 18, 680 active validators, 0.0% of stake delinquent. Alpenglow readiness: validators holding 99% of stake have registered BLS keys ahead of the consensus upgrade. Anomaly scan: 1 signal(s) flagged — see Signals below.
